target.rawSql: SELECT effective_ts AS time, ends_ts AS timeend, airport || ': ' || event AS text, airport AS tags FROM weather_alerts WHERE effective_ts < $__timeTo() AND coalesce(ends_ts, now()) > $__timeFrom()

panels.title: Live NYC airspace
panels.description: Airborne aircraft seen in the last 90 seconds, colored by barometric altitude (m). PRD §10 panel 1.

targets.rawSql: SELECT icao24, callsign, latitude, longitude, baro_alt_m, velocity_ms, track_deg, updated_at FROM live_states WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '90 seconds' AND NOT on_ground AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'JFK' AS airport, 40.6413 AS a_lat, -73.7781 AS a_lon UNION ALL SELECT 'LGA', 40.7769, -73.8740 UNION ALL SELECT 'EWR', 40.6895, -74.1745

panels.title: Current conditions
panels.description: Latest observation per station; flight_category is the operational summary. PRD §10 panel 3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (station) station, obs_ts, text_desc, flight_category, wind_speed_kmh, wind_gust_kmh, visibility_m, ceiling_ft FROM weather_obs ORDER BY station, obs_ts DESC

panels.title: Pipeline freshness
panels.description: Seconds since the newest live_states row — the end-to-end liveness signal (healthy < 90 s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch from now() - max(updated_at)) AS staleness_s FROM live_states

panels.title: Arrivals per 15 min
panels.description: Detected arrivals bucketed to 15 minutes per airport; NWS alert windows overlay as annotations. PRD §10 panel 2.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(event_ts, '15m') AS time, airport AS metric, count(*) AS arrivals FROM flight_events WHERE event_type = 'arrival' AND $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: NWS alert state by airport
panels.description: Every airport holds a row at all times; colored spans are alert windows, dark gaps are clear air. Concurrent alerts show the latest-starting one. PRD §10 panel 5.

targets.rawSql: WITH airports(airport) AS (VALUES ('KJFK'), ('KLGA'), ('KEWR')), baseline AS (SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS ts, a.airport, coalesce((SELECT w.event FROM weather_alerts w WHERE w.airport = a.airport AND w.effective_ts <= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND coalesce(w.ends_ts, 'infinity'::timestamptz) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz ORDER BY w.effective_ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'clear') AS state FROM airports a), changes AS (SELECT effective_ts AS ts, airport, event AS state FROM weather_alerts UNION ALL SELECT ends_ts, airport, 'clear' FROM weather_alerts WHERE ends_ts IS NOT NULL) SELECT ts AS time, airport, state FROM (SELECT * FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT * FROM changes WHERE ts > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz) s ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Airborne delay: holding minutes by airport, go-arounds
panels.description: Hourly holding minutes stacked by airport with go-arounds as points; alert windows overlay. Quiet hours are real zeros, not missing data. PRD §10 panel 4.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(event_ts, '1h', 0) AS time, airport AS metric, round(sum(duration_s) / 60.0, 1) AS value FROM flight_events WHERE event_type = 'holding' AND $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_ts, '1h', 0) AS time, 'go-arounds' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM flight_events WHERE event_type = 'go_around' AND $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Arrival rate vs effective wind
panels.description: Each point is one airport-hour: detected arrivals against effective wind (gust when reported, else sustained), colored by flight category. Visibility joins the story on the analytics dashboard, where 38 years give it range. PRD §10 panel 6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) AS effective_wind_kmh, arrivals_detected FROM analytics.fct_airport_hourly WHERE flight_category = 'VFR' AND coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(hour_ts)

SELECT coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) AS effective_wind_kmh, arrivals_detected FROM analytics.fct_airport_hourly WHERE flight_category = 'MVFR' AND coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(hour_ts)

SELECT coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) AS effective_wind_kmh, arrivals_detected FROM analytics.fct_airport_hourly WHERE flight_category = 'IFR' AND coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(hour_ts)

SELECT coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) AS effective_wind_kmh, arrivals_detected FROM analytics.fct_airport_hourly WHERE flight_category = 'LIFR' AND coalesce(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(hour_ts)
